lead.headline: Saint Mary's beats a top-40 team by 17 and takes every award
lead.deck: The Gaels handled Saint Louis 95-78. Santa Clara, the preseason pick, split two road games and lost at home to VCU.
body: Saint Mary's beat Saint Louis 95-78 at home, and that is a better win than it sounds. Our model has the Billikens 36th in the country. The Gaels closed as 1-point favorites and won by 17. Mantas Juzenas had 25 points and 10 rebounds against them, then 20 more against Menlo. The league office noticed: Saint Mary's swept the WCC's player of the week awards on Monday.

The Gaels are 6-1 and 40th nationally in the model, plus-18.8 per 100 possessions. Nobody else in the conference is within 10 points of that. First in the power rankings again. Next up is Thursday at UCLA.

Santa Clara was picked to win this league in October. This week it lost 83-77 at home to VCU, won a 102-99 shootout at Illinois State behind 29 points and six assists from Sash Gavalyugov, then lost 85-66 at Nevada. The Broncos are still second in the power rankings and 97th in the model. That's a long way behind Saint Mary's.

The climber is San Diego, from ninth to fourth in the power rankings. The Toreros are 6-1 after beating UC Riverside, winning 67-64 at UC Irvine and beating Fordham 80-58. Pacific is 5-1 and third, but our model rates the Tigers' schedule the softest in the league. They play three games in three days starting tonight, at Jacksonville State, Omaha and UC Davis. That will tell us more.
The league went 15-9. Every team in it has at least four wins except Denver, which is 1-5.

column.label: Look Ahead
column.title: Thanksgiving road trips
body: **Saint Mary's at UCLA, Thursday, 5 p.m.** The Gaels' best chance this month at a road win that people will notice. No line yet.

**Pacific at Jacksonville State, tonight, 10:30 p.m.** The Gamecocks are 4-point favorites. Pacific's 63-62 win over Bradley was close. Three games in three days against real teams will show what the 5-1 start is worth.

**UC Irvine at Seattle U, Saturday, 5 p.m.** Seattle U is 5-2 and up to fifth in the power rankings after beating UC San Diego by 26 and Loyola Chicago by 13. The Anteaters lost at home to San Diego and LMU this week, so the Redhawks should be hungry and the Anteaters a little sore.

notes.headline: Portland beat Colorado as a 14.5-point underdog
notes.body: The Pilots won 77-74 at Colorado, and Jaxon Olvera had 22 points. He scored 26 more in an 87-69 home loss to Fordham, then the Pilots lost 79-71 at Cal Baptist.

notes.headline: LMU won two road games as the underdog
notes.body: The Lions won 80-73 at Cal Baptist as 13.5-point underdogs, then won 72-68 at UC Irvine. Jevon Porter had 16 points and eight assists in the first one.

notes.headline: Pepperdine scored 140
notes.body: That came against West Coast Baptist, which isn't a Division I team, and Anto Balian had 13 assists. The Waves also beat UNC Greensboro 89-62 as 10.5-point favorites.

notes.headline: Circle it: Saint Mary's at UCLA
notes.body: Thursday, 5 p.m. ET. The WCC's best team, on the road at UCLA.
